title: kbjob.py cancel ends the wrong job's process group when the executor runs jobs in parallel
goal: kj_follow.group_of finds the process group of the job asked for, not the first child of the executor that leads a group of its own: the job record's member pid names the child of that job, so cancel of one of several running jobs ends that job's group only

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kj_follow, inspect; assert "serve-PID" not in inspect.getsource(kj_follow.group_of)
